description_en: Enumerates the available organization synchronization configurations
description_zh: 枚举可用的组织同步配置
name: ListAvailableConfigs

parameters.help_en: The platform application token issued by the console. If specified, the operation is executed as the user identified by opsUserId or opsUserCode
parameters.help_zh: 平台应用 Token（控制台签发）。传入后将以 opsUserId 或 opsUserCode 指定的用户身份执行
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: The proxy user ID, which is the WINNEXO platform user ID. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as winnexo_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户ID（WINNEXO 平台用户ID），仅当应用凭证配置为 winnexo_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_id

parameters.help_en: The proxy user code, which is unique within the tenant. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as source_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户编码（租户内唯一），仅当应用凭证配置为 source_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_code

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. For winnexo-cli, it is explicitly passed by using --tenant-id
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

200.description_en: 枚举可用的组织同步配置
200.description_zh: 枚举可用的组织同步配置

schema.description_en: The response schema for enumerating available organization synchronization configurations
schema.description_zh: 枚举可用组织同步配置响应

configs.description_en: The list of queried Logtail configurations

items.description_en: The list of queried Logtail configurations

ssoSettingsId.description_en: The SSO configuration ID. This field has a value only for SAML, OAuth2, and WeCom, and is null for custom
ssoSettingsId.description_zh: SSO 配置 ID（仅 SAML/OAuth2/WeCom 有值，custom 为 null）

ssoSettingsName.description_en: The SSO configuration name. This field has a value only for SAML, OAuth2, and WeCom, and is null for custom
ssoSettingsName.description_zh: SSO 配置名称（仅 SAML/OAuth2/WeCom 有值，custom 为 null）
